commit_message: Keep AI Studio transcript at available height
pr_title: Fix AI Studio transcript height regression
pr_body:
## Summary

- Rebased the fix onto current main after the harness update also touched `ai_studio.rs`.
- Keep the centered 960px AI Studio conversation lane from PR #1019.
- Prevent the transcript's horizontal centering row from shrinking to the height of the current entries.
- Make only the transcript lane consume the CentralPanel's available height; header and composer remain content-sized.
- Restore ADR 0158's requirement that the transcript occupy the presentation's available height with the composer pinned below it.
- Supersedes #1021, which became conflicting after current main advanced.

## Validation

- Windows Validation
- Visual Validation of the AI Studio first-release scenarios
